name: PADS Silver
title: PADS Silver Whole-Home Audio Package
description: Mid-tier whole-home audio distribution package with IR remote control. Adds IR detectors to in-wall amplifiers and IR emitter to the sending unit.
detailTitle: PADS Silver Whole-Home Audio Distribution Package
detailDescription: The PADS Silver package is the upgrade from the PADS Bronze, adding IR detectors to the in-wall amplifiers and an IR emitter to the sending unit. This enables remote control of audio in each zone, providing enhanced convenience for whole-home audio distribution.

specifications.value: In-wall amplifier with IR remote control
IR detectors on amplifiers, IR emitter on source

features: IR detectors added to in-wall amplifiers
IR emitter on sending unit for remote control
Wireless remote control of volume and source per zone
applications: Residential whole-home audio with remote control
